subject: Tomorrow is Master's Birthday – Prepare with Luca
body:
Tomorrow is Master's birthday!

This is a special time to reflect on his teachings and his mission to spread the message of divine love and self-realization. As we honor his birth, we can deepen our understanding of his wisdom and draw inspiration from his life.

Here are some questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this day bring you closer to Master's teachings and the path of Kriya Yoga.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
